title: There’s A Kind Of Failure Called Short-Sightedness
english_paragraphs: Two interns joined the company, and I was their supervisor. One day after lunch, I saw one of them playing on her phone. I went over and asked, “I have a document that needs translating. Do you have time to help with it?” The document wasn’t part of her assigned work, but she seemed to have some free time, so I thought it would be a chance for her to practice. She replied, “I do, but I’m just an intern.” For a moment, I didn’t know what to say. I paused, said, “Yes, you are,” and walked away.

I think this intern was short-sighted. It’s true that she was only an intern, her pay was low, and she had already finished her own work. But because of that response, she may have missed out on a better future.

Two interns joined the company, and I was their supervisor. One day after lunch, I saw one of them playing on her phone. I went over and asked, “I have a document that needs translating. Do you have time to help with it?” The document wasn’t part of her assigned work, but she seemed to have some free time, so I thought it would be a chance for her to practice. She replied, “I do, but I’m just an intern.” For a moment, I didn’t know what to say. I paused, said, “Yes, you are,” and walked away.

I think this intern was short-sighted. It’s true that she was only an intern, her pay was low, and she had already finished her own work. But because of that response, she may have missed out on a better future.
russian_paragraphs: Два́ стажёра пришли в компа́нию, и я был их надзира́тель. Одна́жды по́сле обе́да я уви́дел одну́ из них, игра́ющую на своём фо́не. Я подо́шёл и спра́шиваю: "У меня́ е́сть докуме́нт, который ну́жен перевести́. У тебя́ е́сть вре́мя, чтобы помо́чь с э́тим?" Докуме́нт не был ча́стью её назна́ченной рабо́ты, но она, похоже, имела не́сколько свóбодного вре́мени, поэ́тому я думал, что это будет шанс для неё на пра́ктику. Она о́тветила: "У меня́ е́сть вре́мя, но я то́лько стажёр." На миг я не знал, что ска́зать. Я па́узировал, ска́зал: "Да, ты стажёр," и у́шёл.

Я ду́маю, что этот стажёр был близору́ким. Это пра́вда, что она то́лько стажёр, еë зарпла́та была ни́зкой, и она уже́ закончи́ла свою́ рабо́ту. Но из-за этого о́тзыва она, возможно, упустила лу́чшую бу́дущую перспективу.
reading_paragraphs: Dvá stazhëra prishli v kompániyu, i ya byl ikh nadzirýatelʹ. Odnázhdy pósle obéda ya uvídel odnú iz nikh, igráyushchuyu na svoem fóne. Ya podóshël i spróshivayu: "U menyá éstʹ dokument, kotorýi núzhen perevestí. U tebyá éstʹ vremya, chtoby pomóchʹ s étim?" Dokument ne byl chástʹyu yeë naznáchennoy rábota, no ona, pokhozhe, imela néskolʹko svobodnogo vremeni, poémini ya dumal, chto eto budet shans dlya neë na práktiku. Ona otvetila: "U menyá éstʹ vremya, no ya tólʹko stazhër." Na mig ya ne znal, chto skazatʹ. Ya paúziroval, skazal: "Da, ty stazhër," i úshël.

Ya dúmayu, chto etot stazhër byl blizorúkim. Eto pravda, chto ona tólʹko stazhër, yeë zarplata byla nizkoy, i ona uzhe zakonchila svojú rabotu. No iz-za étogo otzýva ona, vozmozhno, upustila luchshuyu búdushchuyu perspektivu.
